_doc: Asset slots: key -> GLB file under ./glb/, real-world size in metres (longest side), optional yaw offset ry. A slot with no file keeps its procedural placeholder. GLBs were remeshed/decimated and textures cut to 1K (see docs/ship3d_plan.md).
